subject: Segmented audit export protocol: delivery, retention and tamper-evidence
messages:
From: Jamie Li <jamie.li@polarbk.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: security@polarbk.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Segmented export capabilities + retention windows

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. PolarBank has one follow-up before we move forward with procurement: we need more detail on how Redwood handles segmented audit exports for compliance reviews. Specific asks from our audit team:

- Ability to export event slices by customer_id, time window, and event_type (e.g., auth, config-change, inference).
- Export formats: NDJSON preferred, CSV acceptable for summary tables.
- Export retention metadata: how long we can request exports for (12/24/36 months) and any constraints for hot vs. cold data.
- Tamper-evidence and chain-of-custody: guarantees and verifiable checksums for exported bundles.
- Transfer options: direct S3 PUT (customer bucket), SCP, or secure presigned URL download (short-lived).

Can you confirm which of the above Redwood supports today, what requires a playbook run vs. engineering support, and approximate timelines/costs? If it helps, our compliance lead Alex Brooks is cc'd.

Appreciate it,

Jamie Li
Director, IT Audit
PolarBank

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Li <jamie.li@polarbk.com>
Cc: security@polarbk.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Segmented export capabilities + retention windows

Hi Jamie — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Karthik (serving/runtime/security) and Marissa (customer success) to give a consolidated answer and the delivery options. High-level summary up front: Redwood supports per-customer and per-event-type slicing and can produce NDJSON/CSV exports. There are two delivery modes: self-service exports (up to 90 days, S3 presigned) and managed bulk exports (longer windows, manifest + S3 PUT or secure transfer).

We'll detail the constraints and steps below. Karthik / Marissa — can you confirm the exact retention windows we can support for managed exports and the expected lead time & cost tiers? Also attaching a draft manifest layout we typically include for handoffs.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales – Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: audit_snapshot_manifest_v1.csv (schema stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Jamie Li <jamie.li@polarbk.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Segmented export capabilities + retention windows

Hi all — adding technical detail and options. I'll break this into three sections: selection/slicing, export delivery modes, and tamper-evidence / provenance.

1) Selection & slicing- We support deterministic query filters across these indices: customer_id, event_type, model_id, start_ts/end_ts. For fidelity-sensitive exports (e.g., inference logs), we can include a KV checksum per record. Exports are produced as line-delimited JSON (NDJSON) by default; CSV summary extracts are available for aggregated fields.

2) Delivery modes- Self-service (nearline):
  - UI/API-driven exports for windows up to 90 days. Produces presigned S3 URLs (7-day expiry), or ad-hoc download. No engineering hours required.
  - Performance: up to 500k records/hour depending on payload size; large exports are throttled.

- Managed bulk exports (runbook):
  - For retention requests >90 days (we typically support up to 36 months for audit purposes) we run a managed job that snapshots the relevant partitions and stages them to an internal staging S3. From there we can do a direct S3 PUT into the customer's bucket (preferred) or provide encrypted archive bundles for download.
  - Lead time: 3-7 business days for small (<=100GB) requests; 7-21 days for TB-scale (depends on queue/backfill).
  - Cost: tiered — baseline data extraction + transfer egress. We'll provide an estimate based on total bytes and requested SLA.

3) Tamper-evidence & provenance- We produce:
  - SHA-256 checksums for each exported file + a manifest file (see attached manifest stub).
  - A signed export receipt (JSON Web Signature) that includes export query, generation timestamp, and the root checksum. This receipt is stored in our retention ledger for 7 years and can be provided to auditors.
  - Optional: timestamping via an external attestation (we can coordinate with a timestamping authority) for additional non-repudiation.

Operational notes:
- Immutable snapshots: managed exports use read-only snapshots to ensure point-in-time consistency; we keep a short-lived staging area for packaging.
- Deletion/TTL: exported copies in the customer's bucket are subject to the customer's lifecycle rules; Redwood removes transient staging copies within 24 hours of confirmed transfer.

Attachments referenced: s3_export_playbook_v2.pdf (playbook for operations), audit_snapshot_manifest_v1.csv

If PolarBank wants, I can schedule a 30-minute ops walkthrough with our export engineers to walk through a small sample export.

— Karthik
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Li <jamie.li@polarbk.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Segmented export capabilities + retention windows

Jamie — thanks for the quick review and Alex for the details in thread. To confirm next steps from Redwood's side: 

1) We'll run a scoped managed export proof (sample slice by customer_id + 6-month window) and produce: NDJSON payload, manifest, signed export receipt, and SHA-256 checksums. Estimated run time: 3 business days once you approve the scope and bucket details.
2) We'll create a short-run DocuSign T&C addendum for managed exports (covers transfer security & acceptance criteria).
3) Ops walkthrough: I'll schedule a 30-minute call for Nov 29 — invite will include our export engineer and Ben (billing) to give a rough cost estimate.

Please confirm: preferred delivery = direct S3 PUT to a PolarBank-managed bucket (please provide bucket ARN and a write role/STS details), and target sample window = 2026-05-01 to 2026-10-31. If that works, we'll seed the job.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales – Redwood Inference
